prompt:
## Are Rights Without Limits?

A speaker uses his freedom of speech to urge a crowd to threaten families who hold different views. He says that this is his right.

**Predict:** Do Fundamental Rights have no limits at all?

options.text: No limits. A Fundamental Right must apply fully, everywhere and always.
Reasonable limits. Restrictions are allowed, but only in accordance with law.
Limits only at election time. The rest of the time there are none.
